fields: The 7/22-7/31 hyperscaler cluster sustains the capex trajectory the WoodMac 55GW high-side demand forecast requires: (i) aggregate FY26 capex guide nets HOLD/RAISE vs the $710-725B baseline AND (ii) ≥2 of the 4 hyperscalers either cite power/energy availability as a constraint or announce new multi-GW datacenter/power commitments on the Q2 calls

if aggregate guide is CUT or ≥2 names flag capex deceleration: the 55GW path loses its funding basis — S3 demand read reverts to PJM-official-32GW-or-below as the funded ceiling, WoodMac excess likely utility self-report artifact (double-counted/speculative requests); flag WATT with the revised verdict for its P3 row

(i) summed FY26 capex guides from GOOGL 7/22 + MSFT/META 7/29 + AMZN 7/30 8-Ks/releases vs $710-725B baseline; (ii) count of the 4 Q2 transcripts containing an explicit power/energy-availability constraint statement or a new multi-GW datacenter/power commitment — threshold ≥2

(i) summed FY26 capex guides from GOOGL 7/22 + MSFT/META 7/29 + AMZN 7/30 8-Ks/releases vs $710-725B baseline; (ii) count of the 4 Q2 transcripts containing an explicit power/energy-availability constraint statement or a new multi-GW datacenter/power commitment — threshold ≥2

HIT (resolved 2026-07-31, confirm-side — the cluster SUSTAINS the 55GW-required capex trajectory): (i) aggregate FY26 capex HELD/RAISE = YES (VULCAN-01 HIT); (ii) >=2 of 4 cite power/energy-availability constraint or announce multi-GW datacenter/power commitments = YES (>=2, likely 3): MSFT 'capacity constrained, demand exceeds available supply' + +1GW added + Fairwater DC + ~$80B power-gated Azure backlog; META 'build tens of gigawatts this decade' (Prometheus/Hyperion multi-GW); AMZN 'still not enough capacity to meet demand.' VERDICT FOR WATT P3: raised capex + power-as-binding-constraint now SUPPORT the WoodMac 55GW HIGH-side, UPGRADING the 7/12 '32GW low-mid funded' read — keep the nameplate-vs-firm caveat (much of 55GW is curtailable/policy-interruptible, DOE 202(c)). Route WATT. Capex root counted once (in VULCAN-01). [KB-043]
